---------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m5p0t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Members, Quorum, MaxRound, NULL

VARIABLES pstate, ballots, holder, roundOf

vars == <<pstate, ballots, holder, roundOf>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ pstate \in [Members -> {"idle", "seeking", "reading", "crashed"}]
    /\ ballots \in [Members -> SUBSET Members]
    /\ holder \in Members \cup {NULL}
    /\ roundOf \in [Members -> 0..MaxRound]

Init ==
    /\ pstate = [m \in Members |-> "idle"]
    /\ ballots = [m \in Members |-> {}]
    /\ holder = NULL
    /\ roundOf = [m \in Members |-> 0]

\* A member opens a fresh reservation round, clearing any stale ballots.
OpenRound(m) ==
    /\ pstate[m] = "idle"
    /\ roundOf[m] < MaxRound
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![m] = "seeking"]
    /\ ballots' = [ballots EXCEPT ![m] = {}]
    /\ roundOf' = [roundOf EXCEPT ![m] = roundOf[m] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED holder

\* A live peer casts one vote for a seeking member's current round.
CastVote(voter, m) ==
    /\ voter # m
    /\ pstate[m] = "seeking"
    /\ pstate[voter] # "crashed"
    /\ voter \notin ballots[m]
    /\ ballots' = [ballots EXCEPT ![m] = ballots[m] \cup {voter}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pstate, holder, roundOf>>

\* With a quorum of ballots and the desk free, the member takes exclusive hold.
TakeDesk(m) ==
    /\ pstate[m] = "seeking"
    /\ Cardinality(ballots[m]) >= Quorum
    /\ holder = NULL
    /\ holder' = m
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![m] = "reading"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ballots, roundOf>>

\* The holder finishes and releases the exclusive desk.
LeaveDesk(m) ==
    /\ pstate[m] = "reading"
    /\ holder = m
    /\ holder' = NULL
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![m] = "idle"]
    /\ ballots' = [ballots EXCEPT ![m] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED roundOf

\* A non-holding member can crash silently at any moment.
Crash(m) ==
    /\ pstate[m] \in {"idle", "seeking"}
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![m] = "crashed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ballots, holder, roundOf>>

\* A crashed member later reboots and rejoins with a clean slate.
Recover(m) ==
    /\ pstate[m] = "crashed"
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![m] = "idle"]
    /\ ballots' = [ballots EXCEPT ![m] = {}]
    /\ roundOf' = [roundOf EXCEPT ![m] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED holder

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Members : OpenRound(m)
    \/ \E voter \in Members, m \in Members : CastVote(voter, m)
    \/ \E m \in Members : TakeDesk(m)
    \/ \E m \in Members : LeaveDesk(m)
    \/ \E m \in Members : Crash(m)
    \/ \E m \in Members : Recover(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The exclusive desk is held by exactly the recorded holder and no one else.
DeskMutex ==
    /\ (holder # NULL => pstate[holder] = "reading")
    /\ (\A m \in Members : pstate[m] = "reading" => holder = m)

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Members = {m1, m2, m3}
    Quorum = 2
    MaxRound = 1
    NULL = NULL
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT DeskMutex
nl:
A library book reservation system lets members compete for exclusive use of a
single high-demand reading desk. Each member is idle, seeking, reading (holding
the desk), or crashed. To claim the desk a member first opens a fresh
reservation round, which clears any stale ballots it had collected and bumps its
round number. Live peers then cast one ballot each for a seeking member's
current round. Once a member has gathered a quorum of ballots and finds the desk
free, it takes exclusive hold and begins reading. The holder later leaves the
desk, freeing it and clearing its ballots. At any moment a member that is not
holding the desk may crash silently and stop participating; a crashed member may
later reboot and rejoin with a clean slate before seeking the desk again.

SAFETY PROPERTY: at every reachable state the exclusive reading desk is held by
exactly the recorded holder -- if a holder is recorded that member is in the
reading state, and any member in the reading state is the recorded holder -- so
no two members ever occupy the critical desk at once.

---- MODULE W4Od1m9p3t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Planes, NumSlots, NULL

Slots == 1 .. NumSlots

VARIABLES slotOwner, planeSlot, epoch, capacity, waiting
vars == << slotOwner, planeSlot, epoch, capacity, waiting >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ slotOwner \in [Slots -> Planes \cup {NULL}]
    /\ planeSlot \in [Planes -> Slots \cup {NULL}]
    /\ epoch \in 0 .. 2
    /\ capacity \in 1 .. NumSlots
    /\ waiting \subseteq Planes

Init ==
    /\ slotOwner = [s \in Slots |-> NULL]
    /\ planeSlot = [p \in Planes |-> NULL]
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ capacity = NumSlots
    /\ waiting = {}

RequestSlot(p) ==
    /\ planeSlot[p] = NULL
    /\ p \notin waiting
    /\ waiting' = waiting \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED << slotOwner, planeSlot, epoch, capacity >>

Allocate(p) ==
    /\ p \in waiting
    /\ \E s \in Slots :
        /\ s <= capacity
        /\ slotOwner[s] = NULL
        /\ slotOwner' = [slotOwner EXCEPT ![s] = p]
        /\ planeSlot' = [planeSlot EXCEPT ![p] = s]
    /\ waiting' = waiting \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, capacity >>

ReleaseSlot(p) ==
    /\ planeSlot[p] # NULL
    /\ slotOwner' = [slotOwner EXCEPT ![planeSlot[p]] = NULL]
    /\ planeSlot' = [planeSlot EXCEPT ![p] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, capacity, waiting >>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ \E nc \in 1 .. NumSlots :
        /\ capacity' = nc
        /\ slotOwner' = [s \in Slots |-> IF s > nc THEN NULL ELSE slotOwner[s]]
        /\ planeSlot' = [p \in Planes |->
                            IF planeSlot[p] # NULL /\ planeSlot[p] > nc
                            THEN NULL ELSE planeSlot[p]]
    /\ epoch' = (epoch + 1) % 3
    /\ UNCHANGED waiting

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Planes : RequestSlot(p)
    \/ \E p \in Planes : Allocate(p)
    \/ \E p \in Planes : ReleaseSlot(p)
    \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleAllocation ==
    \A p \in Planes : planeSlot[p] # NULL => slotOwner[planeSlot[p]] = p
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Planes = {p1, p2, p3}
    NumSlots = 2
    NULL = NULL
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAllocation
nl:
An air-traffic control system allocates landing slots on a bank of runways to
inbound planes. The set of usable slots is reconfigured at runtime, and each
reconfiguration bumps a monotonically cycling epoch number.

Actions:
- RequestSlot(p): a plane p that currently holds no slot and is not already
  waiting joins the waiting queue for a landing slot.
- Allocate(p): a waiting plane p is assigned some currently active, free slot
  (one whose index is within the current capacity and whose owner is empty).
  The central ledger records the slot's owner as p and p records the slot it
  holds, and p leaves the waiting queue.
- ReleaseSlot(p): a plane p holding a slot gives it up; both the ledger owner
  and the plane's held slot are cleared.
- Reconfigure: capacity is changed to a new value and the epoch advances
  (cycling modulo 3). Any slot whose index now exceeds the new capacity is
  deactivated: its ledger owner is cleared and any plane that was parked on it
  is evicted (its held slot is cleared) so the ledger stays coherent.

Reconfigure is always available, so capacity can change at any time and the
system never gets stuck.

SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a plane records that it holds a slot, the central
runway ledger names that same plane as the owner of that slot, so no slot is
ever double-allocated to two different planes.

---- MODULE W4Od6m0p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Controllers, Authorized, MaxVer, NULL

ReqType == [v : 0 .. MaxVer, done : BOOLEAN, at : 0 .. MaxVer]

VARIABLES version, req, floor, commits, lastActor
vars == << version, req, floor, commits, lastActor >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ version \in 0 .. MaxVer
    /\ req \in [Controllers -> ReqType \cup {NULL}]
    /\ floor \in 0 .. MaxVer
    /\ commits \in 0 .. MaxVer
    /\ lastActor \in Controllers \cup {NULL}

Init ==
    /\ version = 0
    /\ req = [c \in Controllers |-> NULL]
    /\ floor = 0
    /\ commits = 0
    /\ lastActor = NULL

Submit(c) ==
    /\ req[c] = NULL
    /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![c] = [v |-> version, done |-> FALSE, at |-> 0]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << version, floor, commits, lastActor >>

Commit(c) ==
    /\ req[c] # NULL
    /\ ~req[c].done
    /\ req[c].v = version
    /\ c \in Authorized
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![c] = [@ EXCEPT !.done = TRUE, !.at = version]]
    /\ floor' = version
    /\ commits' = IF commits < MaxVer THEN commits + 1 ELSE commits
    /\ lastActor' = c

Retry(c) ==
    /\ req[c] # NULL
    /\ ~req[c].done
    /\ req[c].v # version
    /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![c] = [v |-> version, done |-> FALSE, at |-> 0]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << version, floor, commits, lastActor >>

Cancel(c) ==
    /\ req[c] # NULL
    /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![c] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED << version, floor, commits, lastActor >>

ResetLock ==
    /\ version = MaxVer
    /\ version' = 0
    /\ req' = [c \in Controllers |-> NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED << floor, commits, lastActor >>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Submit(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Commit(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Retry(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Cancel(c)
    \/ ResetLock

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleAction ==
    \A c \in Controllers :
        (req[c] # NULL /\ req[c].done)
            => (c \in Authorized /\ req[c].at = req[c].v)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Controllers = {c1, c2}
    Authorized = {c1}
    MaxVer = 2
    NULL = NULL
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleAction
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper is coordinated by controllers that compete for
the right to reprogram the shared dispatch plan. Access uses optimistic locking:
a controller reads the current lock version, prepares a request stamped with
that version, and later tries to commit it. Because request messages can be
reordered in transit, a commit only succeeds if the request's stamped version
still matches the live version at commit time; otherwise the controller retries.

Actions:
- Submit(c): a controller c with no outstanding request reads the current lock
  version and creates a pending request stamped with that version.
- Commit(c): an authorized controller c whose pending request is still stamped
  with the live version commits it. The lock version is advanced by one, the
  request is marked done with its applied-at field set to the version it
  consumed, and the dispatch floor / bookkeeping are updated.
- Retry(c): a controller c whose pending request is now stale (its stamped
  version no longer matches the live version, because someone else committed
  first) re-reads the current version and replaces its request.
- Cancel(c): a controller c abandons its outstanding request (done or not).
- ResetLock: when the version counter reaches its maximum it wraps back to zero
  and all pending requests are cleared, so the system never gets stuck.

SAFETY PROPERTY: every request that has been committed was committed by an
authorized controller and consumed exactly the version it was stamped with, so
no stale or unauthorized participant ever takes effect.

---- MODULE W4Od8m2p5t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Participants

Votes == {"none", "yes", "no"}
Decisions == {"none", "commit", "abort"}
Phases == {"voting", "decided"}

VARIABLES vote, decision, committed, override, phase
vars == << vote, decision, committed, override, phase >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ vote \in [Participants -> Votes]
    /\ decision \in Decisions
    /\ committed \in [Participants -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ override \in BOOLEAN
    /\ phase \in Phases

Init ==
    /\ vote = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]
    /\ decision = "none"
    /\ committed = [p \in Participants |-> FALSE]
    /\ override = FALSE
    /\ phase = "voting"

CastVote(p) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ vote[p] = "none"
    /\ \E b \in {"yes", "no"} : vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![p] = b]
    /\ UNCHANGED << decision, committed, override, phase >>

DecideCommit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A p \in Participants : vote[p] = "yes"
    /\ decision' = "commit"
    /\ phase' = "decided"
    /\ UNCHANGED << vote, committed, override >>

DecideAbort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \E p \in Participants : vote[p] = "no"
    /\ decision' = "abort"
    /\ phase' = "decided"
    /\ UNCHANGED << vote, committed, override >>

AdminOverride ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ decision' = "commit"
    /\ phase' = "decided"
    /\ override' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED << vote, committed >>

Finalize(p) ==
    /\ phase = "decided"
    /\ decision = "commit"
    /\ committed[p] = FALSE
    /\ committed' = [committed EXCEPT ![p] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << vote, decision, override, phase >>

ResetRound ==
    /\ phase = "decided"
    /\ vote' = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]
    /\ decision' = "none"
    /\ committed' = [p \in Participants |-> FALSE]
    /\ override' = FALSE
    /\ phase' = "voting"

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Participants : CastVote(p)
    \/ DecideCommit
    \/ DecideAbort
    \/ AdminOverride
    \/ \E p \in Participants : Finalize(p)
    \/ ResetRound

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

FinalizeOnlyOnCommit ==
    \A p \in Participants : committed[p] => decision = "commit"
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Participants = {s1, s2, s3}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT FinalizeOnlyOnCommit
nl:
A university course-registration system finalizes an enrollment across several
department participants using two-phase commit. Each participant votes on whether
the enrollment can proceed; a coordinator turns the votes into a global decision;
only under a commit decision may a participant perform the irreversible finalize
step (issuing the seat). A privileged admin can override the vote and force the
round to commit.

Actions:
- CastVote(p): a participant p that has not yet voted casts either "yes" or "no"
  while the round is still in the voting phase.
- DecideCommit: when the round is in voting and every participant has voted
  "yes", the coordinator sets the global decision to commit and moves to decided.
- DecideAbort: when the round is in voting and at least one participant voted
  "no", the coordinator sets the global decision to abort and moves to decided.
- AdminOverride: while in voting, the privileged admin forces the global decision
  to commit, records that an override was used, and moves to decided.
- Finalize(p): once the round is decided with a commit decision, a participant p
  that has not yet finalized performs its irreversible finalize step exactly once
  (its committed flag becomes true).
- ResetRound: from the decided phase the round is reset back to voting with all
  votes, the decision, all committed flags, and the override flag cleared, so the
  system never gets stuck.

SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a participant has performed its irreversible finalize
step, the global decision is commit, so the irreversible action never happens
under an abort or an undecided round.

---- MODULE W4Od5m1p5t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS NumPlayers, NULL

Players == 1 .. NumPlayers
NextInRing(p) == (p % NumPlayers) + 1

VARIABLES token, crashed, started, starter, tokenAtStart
vars == << token, crashed, started, starter, tokenAtStart >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Players \cup {NULL}
    /\ crashed \in [Players -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ started \in BOOLEAN
    /\ starter \in Players \cup {NULL}
    /\ tokenAtStart \in Players \cup {NULL}

Init ==
    /\ token = 1
    /\ crashed = [p \in Players |-> FALSE]
    /\ started = FALSE
    /\ starter = NULL
    /\ tokenAtStart = NULL

PassToken(p) ==
    /\ token = p
    /\ ~crashed[p]
    /\ token' = NextInRing(p)
    /\ UNCHANGED << crashed, started, starter, tokenAtStart >>

StartMatch(p) ==
    /\ token = p
    /\ ~crashed[p]
    /\ ~started
    /\ started' = TRUE
    /\ starter' = p
    /\ tokenAtStart' = token
    /\ UNCHANGED << token, crashed >>

CrashSilently(p) ==
    /\ ~crashed[p]
    /\ crashed' = [crashed EXCEPT ![p] = TRUE]
    /\ token' = IF token = p THEN NULL ELSE token
    /\ UNCHANGED << started, starter, tokenAtStart >>

Regenerate ==
    /\ token = NULL
    /\ \E q \in Players : ~crashed[q] /\ token' = q
    /\ UNCHANGED << crashed, started, starter, tokenAtStart >>

Recover(p) ==
    /\ crashed[p]
    /\ crashed' = [crashed EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << token, started, starter, tokenAtStart >>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players : PassToken(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : StartMatch(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : CrashSilently(p)
    \/ Regenerate
    \/ \E p \in Players : Recover(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

StartByTokenHolder ==
    started => (starter # NULL /\ starter = tokenAtStart)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    NumPlayers = 3
    NULL = NULL
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT StartByTokenHolder
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker arranges players in a ring and circulates a
single token that grants exclusive access to start a match. Only the current
token holder may perform the irreversible action of starting the match, and it
may be started at most once. Any player can crash silently; if the crashing
player was holding the token, the token is lost and must be regenerated.

Actions:
- PassToken(p): the live (non-crashed) holder p of the token passes it to the
  next player in the ring.
- StartMatch(p): the live holder p of the token, if the match has not yet been
  started, performs the irreversible start; it records itself as the starter and
  captures the token value it held at that moment.
- CrashSilently(p): a live player p crashes; if it was holding the token, the
  token becomes lost (NULL).
- Regenerate: when the token is lost, a fresh token is handed to some live
  player so the ring can continue.
- Recover(p): a crashed player p rejoins the lobby (becomes live again), which
  guarantees the system is never stuck even if the token landed on a crashed
  player.

SAFETY PROPERTY: if the match has been started, the recorded starter is a real
player and equals the token holder captured at the moment of the start, so the
irreversible match-start is only ever performed by the exclusive token holder.

---- MODULE W4Od5m6p5t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Players, LeaseDur, MaxTime, NULL

VARIABLES clock, leaseOwner, leaseExpiry, committed, committedAt, commitDeadline
vars == << clock, leaseOwner, leaseExpiry, committed, committedAt, commitDeadline >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ clock \in 0 .. MaxTime
    /\ leaseOwner \in Players \cup {NULL}
    /\ leaseExpiry \in 0 .. (MaxTime + LeaseDur)
    /\ committed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ committedAt \in 0 .. MaxTime
    /\ commitDeadline \in 0 .. (MaxTime + LeaseDur)

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ leaseOwner = NULL
    /\ leaseExpiry = 0
    /\ committed = FALSE
    /\ committedAt = 0
    /\ commitDeadline = 0

Acquire(p) ==
    /\ leaseOwner = NULL
    /\ leaseOwner' = p
    /\ leaseExpiry' = clock + LeaseDur
    /\ UNCHANGED << clock, committed, committedAt, commitDeadline >>

Renew(p) ==
    /\ leaseOwner = p
    /\ clock < leaseExpiry
    /\ leaseExpiry' = clock + LeaseDur
    /\ UNCHANGED << clock, leaseOwner, committed, committedAt, commitDeadline >>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxTime
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << leaseOwner, leaseExpiry, committed, committedAt, commitDeadline >>

Expire ==
    /\ leaseOwner # NULL
    /\ clock >= leaseExpiry
    /\ leaseOwner' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED << clock, leaseExpiry, committed, committedAt, commitDeadline >>

Commit(p) ==
    /\ leaseOwner = p
    /\ clock < leaseExpiry
    /\ ~committed
    /\ committed' = TRUE
    /\ committedAt' = clock
    /\ commitDeadline' = leaseExpiry
    /\ UNCHANGED << clock, leaseOwner, leaseExpiry >>

ResetRound ==
    /\ clock = MaxTime
    /\ clock' = 0
    /\ leaseOwner' = NULL
    /\ leaseExpiry' = 0
    /\ committed' = FALSE
    /\ committedAt' = 0
    /\ commitDeadline' = 0

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players : Acquire(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Renew(p)
    \/ Tick
    \/ Expire
    \/ \E p \in Players : Commit(p)
    \/ ResetRound

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CommitWithinLease ==
    committed => committedAt < commitDeadline
====

CONSTANTS
    Players = {a, b, c}
    LeaseDur = 2
    MaxTime = 3
    NULL = NULL
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CommitWithinLease
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker grants ownership of a match slot using a
time-bounded lease. A player acquires the lease with an expiry deadline measured
against a shared clock, and may renew it while it is still valid. The
irreversible action of committing the match may be performed at most once, and
only by the current lease holder while the lease is still live. A slow (but not
failed) player might try to commit against a lease that has already expired; such
a commit must be rejected.

Actions:
- Acquire(p): when no player owns the lease, player p takes it with an expiry set
  to the current clock plus the lease duration.
- Renew(p): the current owner p extends its still-valid lease to a fresh expiry.
- Tick: the shared clock advances by one, which can push a lease past its expiry.
- Expire: an owned lease whose expiry the clock has reached or passed is
  reclaimed (owner cleared).
- Commit(p): the current owner p, while its lease is still live (clock strictly
  before expiry) and no commit has yet happened, performs the irreversible commit
  exactly once, recording the time of commit and the lease deadline it committed
  under.
- ResetRound: when the clock reaches its maximum, the round resets (clock, lease,
  and commit records cleared) so the system never gets stuck.

SAFETY PROPERTY: if the match has been committed, the time it was committed is
strictly before the lease deadline it committed under, so a slow participant can
never commit on an expired lease.

---- MODULE W4Od9m3p0t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Nodes, NULL, MaxTerm

VARIABLES role, free, transit, term, reqs
vars == <<role, free, transit, term, reqs>>

ActiveNodes == {n \in Nodes : role[n] = "active"}
InTransit == IF transit = NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1

TypeOK ==
    /\ role \in [Nodes -> {"idle", "active"}]
    /\ free \in 0..1
    /\ transit \in Nodes \cup {NULL}
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ reqs \subseteq Nodes

Init ==
    /\ role = [n \in Nodes |-> "idle"]
    /\ free = 1
    /\ transit = NULL
    /\ term = 0
    /\ reqs = {}

Request(n) ==
    /\ role[n] = "idle"
    /\ n \notin reqs
    /\ transit # n
    /\ reqs' = reqs \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<role, free, transit, term>>

Grant(n) ==
    /\ free = 1
    /\ n \in reqs
    /\ free' = 0
    /\ transit' = n
    /\ term' = IF term < MaxTerm THEN term + 1 ELSE term
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED role

Failover(n) ==
    /\ transit # NULL
    /\ transit # n
    /\ n \in reqs
    /\ transit' = n
    /\ term' = IF term < MaxTerm THEN term + 1 ELSE term
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<role, free>>

Enter(n) ==
    /\ transit = n
    /\ role[n] = "idle"
    /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![n] = "active"]
    /\ transit' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED <<free, term, reqs>>

Release(n) ==
    /\ role[n] = "active"
    /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![n] = "idle"]
    /\ free' = 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<transit, term, reqs>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Request(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Grant(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Failover(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Enter(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Release(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutualExclusion ==
    free + InTransit + Cardinality(ActiveNodes) = 1
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {n1, n2}
    NULL = NULL
    MaxTerm = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutualExclusion
nl:
A regional power-grid load shedder is driven by a single critical actuator. Control nodes
coordinate through leader election with failover to decide which node may drive it, and a
single control permit represents the right to drive the actuator. The permit is always in one
of three places: resting in the free pool, in transit toward an elected node over a channel
whose grant messages may be reordered, or held by a node that is actively shedding load.

A node that is not driving the actuator posts a request to be considered (Request). When the
permit rests in the pool, the current leader grants it to a requesting node, moving it out of
the pool into transit toward that node and opening a new election term (Grant). Because grant
messages can be reordered and a leader can change its mind, a failover can reroute an in-transit
permit to a different requesting node under a higher term (Failover). When the permit reaches
its destination, that node takes hold of it and begins driving the actuator (Enter). When the
node finishes shedding load, it releases the permit back to the free pool (Release).

SAFETY PROPERTY: The single control permit is conserved -- the count in the free pool, the count
in transit, and the number of nodes actively driving the actuator always sum to one -- so at most
one node ever drives the critical actuator at a time.

    /\ ver \in [Slots -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ rd \in [Bags -> {NULL} \cup [slot : Slots, v : 0..MaxVer]]

    /\ rd = [b \in Bags |-> NULL]

    /\ ver[rd[b].slot] = rd[b].v

    /\ placedSlot' = [placedSlot EXCEPT ![b] = rd[b].slot]

    /\ rd' = [rd EXCEPT ![b] = NULL]

    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, placedSlot, ver, capacity>>

    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![placedSlot[b]] = NULL]
    /\ placedSlot' = [placedSlot EXCEPT ![b] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, rd, capacity>>

    /\ \E c \in 1..NumSlots :

        /\ capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, placedSlot, ver, rd>>

    Slots = {s1, s2}

    MaxVer = 1

nl:
An airport baggage router assigns bags to discharge slots using optimistic locking with retry.
Each slot carries a version number. The set of usable slots (the capacity) can change at runtime
as chutes are opened or closed for maintenance.

A waiting bag optimistically reads a target slot's current version, remembering the slot and the
version it saw (Begin). It then attempts to commit by compare-and-swap: only if the slot's version
still matches what it read, the slot is still free, and the slot is within the current capacity,
does the assignment succeed -- the slot records the bag, the bag records the slot, and the slot's
version is bumped (Commit). If the version has moved, the slot is taken, or the version is
exhausted, the bag abandons its attempt and will retry from a fresh read (Retry). A placed bag can
later leave its slot, freeing it for reuse (Release). Independently, an operator can change the
active capacity to any nonempty set of slots at any time (ChangeCapacity).

SAFETY PROPERTY: The bag-to-slot view and the slot-to-bag view of the assignment agree exactly, so
no slot is ever allocated to two different bags at once.

VoteMsgs == [prop : Proposals, bank : Banks]

    /\ tally \in [Proposals -> SUBSET Banks]

    /\ tally = [p \in Proposals |-> {}]

    /\ phase[p] = "idle"
    /\ avail > 0
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![p] = "voting"]
    /\ avail' = avail - 1
    /\ tally' = [tally EXCEPT ![p] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED msgs

    /\ phase[p] = "voting"
    /\ bk \notin tally[p]
    /\ [prop |-> p, bank |-> bk] \notin msgs
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {[prop |-> p, bank |-> bk]}

    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![p] = "idle"]
    /\ avail' = avail + 1
    /\ tally' = [tally EXCEPT ![p] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED msgs

    /\ phase[p] = "settled"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![p] = "idle"]
    /\ avail' = avail + 1
    /\ tally' = [tally EXCEPT ![p] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED msgs

    \/ \E p \in Proposals : Open(p)
    \/ \E bk \in Banks, p \in Proposals : CastVote(bk, p)
    \/ DeliverVote
    \/ \E p \in Proposals : Settle(p)
    \/ \E p \in Proposals : Abort(p)
    \/ \E p \in Proposals : Reclaim(p)

    Banks = {a, b, c}
    Proposals = {p1, p2}
    Capacity = 1
    Quorum = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next

nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch processes proposed transfers against a shared settlement
pool of bounded capacity. Each proposed settlement must gather a quorum of member-bank votes
before it is applied, and vote messages travel on a channel where they may be reordered.

An idle proposal is opened only if the pool has spare capacity, reserving one capacity unit and
clearing its vote tally (Open). A member bank casts a vote for a proposal that is currently
voting, putting a vote message on the wire (CastVote). Vote messages are delivered in an arbitrary
order, each adding its bank to the target proposal's running tally (DeliverVote). Once a proposal's
tally reaches the quorum, it settles, consuming its reserved unit as committed (Settle). A voting
proposal that stalls can be aborted, returning its reserved unit to the pool (Abort). A settled
proposal is eventually reclaimed at the end of the batch, returning its unit to the pool for
reuse (Reclaim).

SAFETY PROPERTY: The pool's free units, the units reserved by voting proposals, and the units
consumed by settled proposals always sum to the fixed capacity, so the committed settlements
never exceed the bounded capacity.

    Cranes = {c1, c2}
    Total = 2
    MaxReg = 2

nl:
In a container-ship crane yard, a fixed number of containers move between the dockside yard
and the ship's hold. Two cranes cooperate through a shared compare-and-swap slot register that
serializes loading onto the ship. A crane may be slow (its cached read of the register goes
stale) but never fails outright, so every crane eventually retries.

A crane reads the current value of the shared register into its local cache (ReadReg). An empty
crane picks a container off the yard, decrementing the yard count and marking itself loaded
(Pickup). To load its container onto the ship, a crane performs a compare-and-swap: only if the
register still equals the value it last read does the swap succeed, bumping the register,
incrementing the ship's hold, and emptying the crane (Load). If the register no longer matches
its cached read -- because a peer crane loaded first -- or the register is saturated, the crane
re-reads and tries again without moving any container (Retry). Containers can also flow back:
an empty crane returns one container from the ship to the yard (Return).

SAFETY PROPERTY: The total number of containers -- those in the yard, those in the ship's hold,
and those currently carried by cranes -- always equals the fixed initial total; none is ever
created or destroyed.

    /\ escrow = 0
    /\ held = [t \in Traders |-> 0]
    /\ expiry = [t \in Traders |-> 0]

    Traders = {t1, t2}
    Total = 2
    LeaseDur = 1
    MaxTime = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next

nl:
A stock exchange opening auction allocates a fixed quantity of shares through lease-based
ownership with expiry. Shares live in three places: the uncommitted pool, the auction escrow
(committed to the book but not yet leased), and the leases currently held by traders. A trader
can crash silently at any moment, so leases are reclaimed by expiry rather than by trusting the
holder to return them.

A share is committed from the pool into the auction escrow (Commit). An active trader takes a
lease on an escrowed share, moving it out of escrow and stamping an expiry time (Lease). A
holding active trader may renew its lease before it expires, pushing the expiry further out
(Renew). When the clock reaches a lease's expiry, the share is reclaimed to the pool regardless
of whether the holder is still alive -- this is how a silently crashed trader's shares are
recovered (Expire). An active trader may also voluntarily release its lease early, returning the
share to the pool (Release). A trader may crash silently (Crash) and later come back (Recover).
The auction clock advances one tick at a time (Tick).

SAFETY PROPERTY: The shares in the pool, the shares in escrow, and the shares held under active
leases always sum to the fixed total, so no share is ever created or destroyed.

EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Students

VARIABLES version, enrolled, pc, snap, ecount
vars == <<version, enrolled, pc, snap, ecount>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ version \in Nat
    /\ enrolled \subseteq Students
    /\ pc \in [Students -> {"idle", "trying", "done", "crashed"}]
    /\ snap \in [Students -> Nat]
    /\ ecount \in [Students -> Nat]

Init ==
    /\ version = 0
    /\ enrolled = {}
    /\ pc = [s \in Students |-> "idle"]
    /\ snap = [s \in Students |-> 0]
    /\ ecount = [s \in Students |-> 0]

\* A student takes an optimistic snapshot of the seat-table version.
Read(s) ==
    /\ pc[s] = "idle"
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![s] = "trying"]
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![s] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, enrolled, ecount>>

\* Commit only if the snapshot still matches and the student is not enrolled.
Commit(s) ==
    /\ pc[s] = "trying"
    /\ snap[s] = version
    /\ s \notin enrolled
    /\ enrolled' = enrolled \cup {s}
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ ecount' = [ecount EXCEPT ![s] = ecount[s] + 1]
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![s] = "done"]
    /\ UNCHANGED snap

\* A concurrent commit bumped the version; abandon and re-read.
Retry(s) ==
    /\ pc[s] = "trying"
    /\ snap[s] # version
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![s] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, enrolled, snap, ecount>>

\* A student's client can silently crash before finishing.
Crash(s) ==
    /\ pc[s] \notin {"done", "crashed"}
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![s] = "crashed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, enrolled, snap, ecount>>

\* Recover a finished or crashed session back to idle (enrollment persists).
Reset(s) ==
    /\ pc[s] \in {"done", "crashed"}
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![s] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, enrolled, snap, ecount>>

Next ==
    \E s \in Students :
        \/ Read(s)
        \/ Commit(s)
        \/ Retry(s)
        \/ Crash(s)
        \/ Reset(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The irreversible enrollment happens at most once per student.
AtMostOnceEnroll == \A s \in Students : ecount[s] <= 1
====

NEXT Next

A university course-registration system lets students claim a limited seat using
optimistic locking with retry. The seat table carries a version counter. A student
first reads the current version (Read), taking a private snapshot. To finalize, the
student attempts to Commit: this succeeds only if the snapshot still equals the live
version and the student is not already enrolled, at which point the seat is granted,
the version is bumped, and the student's enrollment counter is incremented. If a
concurrent commit changed the version, the student's snapshot is stale and it must
Retry, returning to idle to re-read. A student's client can silently Crash at any
point before it finishes. A crashed or finished session may later Reset back to idle
for a fresh attempt, but the persistent enrollment record is never cleared, so a
returning student cannot enroll a second time.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Each student's irreversible enrollment action is applied at most once.

    /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![d] = "no"]

    \/ Reset

commit. A coordinator drives the decision; each surveillance drone is a participant.

voted yes and no commit has yet occurred, marking the decision committed and recording
one commit in a persistent tally. If a unanimous-yes commit is not available -- because
some drone voted no, crashed, or has not yet voted -- the coordinator may Abort. After
any decision the swarm Resets: drones re-arm to working and votes clear for a new round,
but the persistent commit tally is never reset, so no second irreversible drop can ever
be committed.

    /\ owner \in [Slots -> Cranes \cup {NULL}]
    /\ phase \in [Cranes -> {"idle", "reading", "holding"}]
    /\ target \in [Cranes -> Slots \cup {NULL}]
    /\ readOwner \in [Cranes -> Cranes \cup {NULL}]
    /\ openSlots \subseteq Slots

    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> NULL]
    /\ phase = [c \in Cranes |-> "idle"]
    /\ target = [c \in Cranes |-> NULL]
    /\ readOwner = [c \in Cranes |-> NULL]
    /\ openSlots = Slots

\* A crane picks a currently-open slot and reads its ownership optimistically.
Begin(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "idle"
    /\ \E s \in openSlots :
        /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![c] = s]
        /\ readOwner' = [readOwner EXCEPT ![c] = owner[s]]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "reading"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, openSlots>>

\* Compare-and-swap: claim the slot only if it is still open and unchanged (free).
Claim(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "reading"
    /\ target[c] \in openSlots
    /\ owner[target[c]] = readOwner[c]
    /\ readOwner[c] = NULL
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![target[c]] = c]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "holding"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<target, readOwner, openSlots>>

\* The slot changed under the crane, or was closed; abandon and retry.
Retry(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "reading"
    /\ (owner[target[c]] # readOwner[c] \/ target[c] \notin openSlots)
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, target, readOwner, openSlots>>

\* A crane releases the slot it holds, freeing it.
Release(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "holding"
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![target[c]] = NULL]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<target, readOwner, openSlots>>

\* Yard capacity changes at runtime: the set of open slots is reconfigured.
Reconfig ==
    /\ \E S \in (SUBSET Slots) \ {{}} : openSlots' = S
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, phase, target, readOwner>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Begin(c) \/ Claim(c) \/ Retry(c) \/ Release(c)
    \/ Reconfig

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every crane that holds a slot is the registered owner of that slot,
\* so a slot is never allocated to two cranes at once.

one of the currently-open slots and reading its ownership into a private snapshot,

EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Controllers, Capacity

vars == <<occupied, phase, snap, admin>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ occupied \in 0..Capacity
    /\ phase \in [Controllers -> {"idle", "reading"}]
    /\ snap \in [Controllers -> 0..Capacity]
    /\ admin \in {"off", "engaged"}

Init ==
    /\ occupied = 0
    /\ phase = [c \in Controllers |-> "idle"]
    /\ snap = [c \in Controllers |-> 0]
    /\ admin = "off"

\* A controller reads the runway-occupancy register into a private snapshot.
Read(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "idle"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "reading"]
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![c] = occupied]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupied, admin>>

\* Compare-and-swap admit: succeeds only if the register is unchanged and below cap.
CasCommit(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "reading"
    /\ snap[c] = occupied
    /\ occupied < Capacity
    /\ occupied' = occupied + 1
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, admin>>

\* The CAS fails because the register moved or the runway is full.
CasFail(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "reading"
    /\ (snap[c] # occupied \/ occupied >= Capacity)
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupied, snap, admin>>

\* An aircraft clears the runway, decrementing occupancy.
Depart ==
    /\ occupied > 0
    /\ occupied' = occupied - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, snap, admin>>

\* The privileged admin engages override mode.
AdminEngage ==
    /\ admin = "off"
    /\ admin' = "engaged"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupied, phase, snap>>

\* Admin override admits an aircraft directly, bypassing the CAS handshake,
\* but still respects the hard runway capacity bound.
AdminForce ==
    /\ admin = "engaged"
    /\ occupied < Capacity
    /\ occupied' = occupied + 1
    /\ admin' = "off"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, snap>>

\* Admin override clears the runway in an emergency.
AdminClear ==
    /\ admin = "engaged"
    /\ occupied' = 0
    /\ admin' = "off"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, snap>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Read(c) \/ CasCommit(c) \/ CasFail(c)
    \/ Depart
    \/ AdminEngage
    \/ AdminForce
    \/ AdminClear

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The runway's bounded capacity is never exceeded.
BoundedCapacity == occupied <= Capacity
====

aircraft first checks the capacity bound.

conserves parcels: a fixed number of parcels always exist somewhere in the
system and are never created or destroyed.

The stages are a source dock, a bounded inbound queue (backpressure: nothing may
be enqueued once the queue reaches its capacity), the robots that are each
carrying at most one parcel, and a delivered bin.

Actions:
- Enqueue: while the source dock is non-empty and the inbound queue is below
  capacity, move one parcel from the dock into the queue.
- Pickup(r): an idle robot r picks up one parcel from the queue.
- Deliver(r): a robot r carrying a parcel drops it into the delivered bin.
- AdminOverride: a privileged administrator bypasses the robots and pulls one
  parcel directly from the queue into the delivered bin, recording that an
  override occurred.
- Recycle: one delivered parcel is sent back to the source dock so the pipeline
  never terminates.

discards a parcel.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The parcels at the source, in the queue, being carried, and
delivered always sum to the fixed total, so nothing is ever created or destroyed.

EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Locks, Quorum, MaxVer, NULL

VARIABLES record, log, pending, votes, crashed

vars == <<record, log, pending, votes, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ record \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ log \in Seq(0..MaxVer)
    /\ pending \in (0..MaxVer) \cup {NULL}
    /\ votes \subseteq Locks
    /\ crashed \subseteq Locks

Init ==
    /\ record = 0
    /\ log = <<>>
    /\ pending = NULL
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ crashed = {}

Propose ==
    /\ pending = NULL
    /\ record < MaxVer
    /\ pending' = record + 1
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, log, crashed>>

CastVote(n) ==
    /\ pending # NULL
    /\ n \notin crashed
    /\ n \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, log, pending, crashed>>

Commit ==
    /\ pending # NULL
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
    /\ log' = Append(log, pending)
    /\ record' = pending
    /\ pending' = NULL
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Crash(n) ==
    /\ n \notin crashed
    /\ Cardinality(crashed) < 1
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, log, pending, votes>>

Recover(n) ==
    /\ n \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, log, pending, votes>>

    \/ Commit
    \/ \E n \in Locks : Crash(n)
    \/ \E n \in Locks : Recover(n)

NoLostUpdate ==
    /\ (Len(log) = 0 => record = 0)
    /\ (Len(log) > 0 => record = log[Len(log)])

CONSTANTS
    Locks = {n1, n2, n3}
    Quorum = 2
    MaxVer = 3
    NULL = NULL
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network keeps one shared configuration record (a
version-stamped setting) that every lock must agree on. Each change to the
record is decided by quorum voting so that no update is ever lost or applied out
of order. The committed history of the record is kept as an append-only log.

Participants are the individual locks. One lock may crash silently at any time
and then stops voting until it recovers; the network tolerates a single crashed
lock because a quorum of the remaining locks can still decide.

Actions:
- Propose: when no change is pending, propose the next version (one greater than
  the current record) and clear the vote set.
- CastVote(n): a non-crashed lock n that has not yet voted votes for the pending
  change.
- Commit: once a quorum of votes is collected, append the pending version to the
  log, install it as the current record, and clear the pending proposal.
- Crash(n): a lock n crashes silently (at most one lock may be crashed at a
  time); a crashed lock casts no votes.
- Recover(n): a crashed lock n comes back online.

Because each commit installs the proposed version as the record and appends it,
the log is strictly increasing and the record always mirrors the newest commit.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The current record always equals the most recently committed
log entry and the committed log is strictly increasing, so no update is lost.

    /\ view \in [Trains -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ capBound \in 1..MaxCap

    /\ view = [t \in Trains |-> 0]

    /\ pos[t] = OUTSIDE
    /\ view[t] = epoch
    /\ \E b \in Blocks :
        /\ Occ(b) < capBound
        /\ pos' = [pos EXCEPT ![t] = b]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, view, capBound>>

Advance(t) ==
    /\ pos[t] \in Blocks
    /\ view[t] = epoch
    /\ \E b \in Blocks :
        /\ b # pos[t]
        /\ Occ(b) < capBound
        /\ pos' = [pos EXCEPT ![t] = b]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, view, capBound>>

    /\ pos[t] \in Blocks
    /\ pos' = [pos EXCEPT ![t] = OUTSIDE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, view, capBound>>

    /\ \E c \in 1..MaxCap :
        /\ \A b \in Blocks : Occ(b) <= c
        /\ capBound' = c
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pos, view>>

Resync(t) ==
    /\ view[t] # epoch
    /\ view' = [view EXCEPT ![t] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pos, epoch, capBound>>

    \/ \E t \in Trains : Advance(t)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Leave(t)
    \/ Reconfigure

CONSTANTS

    Blocks = {b1, b2}
    OUTSIDE = OUTSIDE
    MaxEpoch = 2
    MaxCap = 2
INIT Init

INVARIANT CapacitySafe
nl:
A subway signalling system divides the track into fixed blocks. Each block has a
capacity limiting how many trains may occupy it at once, and the signalling
authority never lets a block exceed that capacity. The authority occasionally
performs an epoch-numbered reconfiguration that changes the capacity bound; each
train carries the epoch it has last observed and must resync to the current epoch
before it is allowed to move.

A train can be slow (lagging several epochs behind) but is never treated as
failed: it simply cannot enter or advance until it catches up, yet it may always
leave the track.

Actions:
- Enter(t): a train t outside the system, whose observed epoch matches the
  current epoch, enters a block that is below capacity.
- Advance(t): an up-to-date train t moves from its current block to a different
  block that is below capacity.
- Leave(t): a train t currently on the track leaves (allowed regardless of epoch).
- Reconfigure: the authority bumps the epoch and installs a new capacity bound
  that is at least the current occupancy of every block (a safe reconfiguration).
- Resync(t): a slow train t updates its observed epoch to the current epoch.

Entry and advance are always gated on the destination block being strictly below
the capacity bound, and reconfiguration never lowers the bound below existing
occupancy.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every block's occupancy is always less than or equal to the
current capacity bound.

    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch

    /\ poolSize = 2

    /\ Load < poolSize

    /\ used' = [used EXCEPT ![s] = used[s] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<poolSize, epoch, iview>>

    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ \E p \in 1..MaxPool :
        /\ p >= Load
        /\ poolSize' = p
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1

    /\ iview' = [iview EXCEPT ![s] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<used, poolSize, epoch>>

    \/ \E s \in Spoolers : Finish(s)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E s \in Spoolers : Resync(s)

nl:
A print shop runs two independent spooler instances that share a single common
pool of buffer slots. The pool has a bounded size that the shop never lets the
combined load exceed. The pool is resized by an epoch-numbered reconfiguration;
each spooler instance carries the epoch it last observed and must resync to the
current epoch before it may submit new jobs.

Because two independent instances draw from one pool, backpressure is applied on
the combined load: a submission is refused whenever the total slots used across
both instances have reached the pool size.

Actions:
- Submit(s): an up-to-date instance s occupies one more slot, provided the
  combined load across both instances is below the pool size.
- Finish(s): an instance s completes a job and releases one of its slots.
- Reconfigure: the shop bumps the epoch and installs a new pool size that is at
  least the current combined load (a safe resize that never strands live jobs).
- Resync(s): a lagging instance s updates its observed epoch to the current one.

The combined load only grows when it is strictly below the pool size, and resizing
never drops the pool size below the current combined load.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The combined number of slots used across both spooler instances
is always less than or equal to the shared pool size.

nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker counts the units of blood held in a fridge whose
bounded capacity must never be exceeded. Every change to the inventory - adding a
unit or removing a unit - is authorized by quorum voting among the staff nodes.
Vote messages travel over an asynchronous channel and can be reordered: a vote
may be delivered in any order relative to the others.

Actions:
- ProposeAdd: when no operation is in flight and the stock is below capacity,
  propose adding one unit and reset the ballot.
- ProposeRem: when no operation is in flight and the stock is positive, propose
  removing one unit and reset the ballot.
- SendVote(n): a node n emits a vote message for the pending operation into the
  channel.
- DeliverVote(n): a vote message from node n is delivered from the channel (in
  any order) and counted in the tally.
- Commit: once the tally reaches quorum, apply the pending operation - increment
  the stock for an add, decrement it for a remove - and clear the ballot.
- Abort: the pending operation is abandoned and the ballot cleared.

An add is only ever proposed while the stock is strictly below capacity, and the
stock is frozen while a ballot is open, so a committed add can never push the
stock past capacity.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The recorded blood stock never exceeds the fridge capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od7m2p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Cranes, Values, Caps

VARIABLES tmState, vote, record, proposal, capacity
vars == <<tmState, vote, record, proposal, capacity>>

\* Two-phase commit updating a shared crane-yard container tally.
TypeOK ==
    /\ tmState \in {"init", "proposed", "committed", "aborted"}
    /\ vote \in [Cranes -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
    /\ record \in Values
    /\ proposal \in Values
    /\ capacity \in Caps

Init ==
    /\ tmState = "init"
    /\ vote = [c \in Cranes |-> "none"]
    /\ record = 0
    /\ proposal = 0
    /\ capacity = 1

\* Coordinator opens a transaction proposing a new tally.
Propose(v) ==
    /\ tmState = "init"
    /\ proposal' = v
    /\ tmState' = "proposed"
    /\ vote' = [c \in Cranes |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, capacity>>

\* A crane accepts because the proposal fits current yard capacity.
VoteYes(c) ==
    /\ tmState = "proposed"
    /\ vote[c] = "none"
    /\ proposal <= capacity
    /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![c] = "yes"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tmState, record, proposal, capacity>>

\* A crane vetoes because the proposal would overflow the yard.
VoteNo(c) ==
    /\ tmState = "proposed"
    /\ vote[c] = "none"
    /\ proposal > capacity
    /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![c] = "no"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tmState, record, proposal, capacity>>

\* Commit only when every crane has agreed; the record takes the proposal.
Commit ==
    /\ tmState = "proposed"
    /\ \A c \in Cranes : vote[c] = "yes"
    /\ record' = proposal
    /\ tmState' = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, proposal, capacity>>

\* Abort on any veto; the shared record is left untouched.
Abort ==
    /\ tmState = "proposed"
    /\ \E c \in Cranes : vote[c] = "no"
    /\ tmState' = "aborted"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, record, proposal, capacity>>

\* Yard capacity is reconfigured at runtime between transactions.
ChangeCapacity(k) ==
    /\ capacity' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tmState, vote, record, proposal>>

\* Clear a finished transaction so the coordinator can start again.
Reset ==
    /\ tmState \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ tmState' = "init"
    /\ proposal' = 0
    /\ vote' = [c \in Cranes |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, capacity>>

Next ==
    \/ \E v \in Values : Propose(v)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : VoteYes(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : VoteNo(c)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ \E k \in Caps : ChangeCapacity(k)
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost update: a committed tally reflects the unanimous agreement of
\* every crane, so no participant's decision is silently overwritten.
NoLostUpdate == (tmState = "committed") => (\A c \in Cranes : vote[c] = "yes")

nl:
A container-ship crane yard keeps a single shared record of how many containers
are stacked in the yard. Cranes update this record through a two-phase commit
coordinated by the yard controller.

The controller opens a transaction by proposing a new tally (Propose) and clears
each crane's ballot. Each crane then votes: it accepts (VoteYes) when the
proposed tally still fits the yard's current capacity, or vetoes (VoteNo) when
the proposal would overflow the yard. The controller commits (Commit) only after
every crane has voted yes, writing the agreed tally into the shared record; if
any crane vetoes, the transaction aborts (Abort) and the record is left
unchanged. Yard capacity is reconfigured at runtime between transactions
(ChangeCapacity) as bays open and close. Once a transaction has committed or
aborted, the controller resets (Reset) and can start a fresh proposal.

SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a transaction is in the committed state, every crane
voted yes for it, so no crane's decision is ever lost or overwritten.

CONSTANTS Drones, NULL

MaxVer == 3
MaxGrant == 4

VARIABLES owner, snap, recVer, recVal, issued
vars == <<owner, snap, recVer, recVal, issued>>

\* A shared survey record is written under a fencing lease; snap[d] is the
\* record version drone d observed when it was granted its lease.
TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in Drones \cup {NULL}
    /\ snap \in [Drones -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ recVer \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ recVal \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ issued \in 0..MaxGrant

Init ==
    /\ owner = NULL
    /\ snap = [d \in Drones |-> 0]
    /\ recVer = 0
    /\ recVal = 0
    /\ issued = 0

\* Lease manager A cold-grants the free record to a drone, snapshotting the
\* current record version into that drone's lease.
GrantCold(d) ==
    /\ owner = NULL
    /\ issued < MaxGrant
    /\ owner' = d
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = recVer]
    /\ issued' = issued + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<recVer, recVal>>

\* Lease manager B preempts the current holder, drawing from the same pool.
GrantPreempt(d) ==
    /\ owner # NULL
    /\ owner # d
    /\ issued < MaxGrant
    /\ owner' = d
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = recVer]
    /\ issued' = issued + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<recVer, recVal>>

\* The holder writes only if its lease snapshot still matches the record
\* version; the write advances the version and refreshes the snapshot.
Write(d) ==
    /\ owner = d
    /\ snap[d] = recVer
    /\ recVer < MaxVer
    /\ recVer' = recVer + 1
    /\ recVal' = recVer + 1
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = recVer + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, issued>>

\* The holder releases the record.
Release ==
    /\ owner # NULL
    /\ owner' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, recVer, recVal, issued>>

\* The swarm re-initialises a fresh surveillance epoch once the pool is spent.
Recycle ==
    /\ (recVer >= MaxVer \/ issued >= MaxGrant)
    /\ owner' = NULL
    /\ snap' = [d \in Drones |-> 0]
    /\ recVer' = 0
    /\ recVal' = 0
    /\ issued' = 0

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : GrantCold(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : GrantPreempt(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Write(d)
    \/ Release
    \/ Recycle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost update: the drone currently holding the lease always has an
\* observed snapshot equal to the live record version, so it can only write
\* on top of the version it actually read.
NoLostUpdate == (owner # NULL) => (snap[owner] = recVer)

A wildfire drone surveillance swarm shares a single sector-survey record. Access
is governed by an expiring lease with a fencing snapshot: when a drone is granted
the lease it records the record version it observed at grant time.

Two independent lease managers draw from the same lease pool over the one record.
Manager A cold-grants the free record to a drone (GrantCold); manager B preempts
whichever drone currently holds the lease and reassigns it (GrantPreempt). Both
increment the shared issued-lease counter. The lease holder writes its survey
update to the record only when its snapshot still equals the live record version
(Write); the write advances the version and refreshes the holder's snapshot so a
preempted drone can never clobber a newer update. A holder can release the record
(Release), and once the shared lease pool is spent the swarm re-initialises a
fresh surveillance epoch (Recycle).

SAFETY PROPERTY: the drone currently holding the lease always has a snapshot
equal to the live record version, so no update is written on top of a stale read.

---- MODULE W4Od12m5p4t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Nodes, Amounts, CapLevels

VARIABLES stock, capacity, ballot, proposal, mode
vars == <<stock, capacity, ballot, proposal, mode>>

QuorumSize == (Cardinality(Nodes) \div 2) + 1

TypeOK ==
    /\ stock \in 0..3
    /\ capacity \in CapLevels
    /\ ballot \in [Nodes -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
    /\ proposal \in {0} \cup Amounts
    /\ mode \in {"idle", "voting"}

Init ==
    /\ stock = 0
    /\ capacity = 2
    /\ ballot = [n \in Nodes |-> "none"]
    /\ proposal = 0
    /\ mode = "idle"

\* A clerk proposes depositing a batch of blood units into the shared stock.
Propose(a) ==
    /\ mode = "idle"
    /\ proposal' = a
    /\ mode' = "voting"
    /\ ballot' = [n \in Nodes |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, capacity>>

\* A node approves the deposit because the result fits the fridge capacity.
ApproveYes(n) ==
    /\ mode = "voting"
    /\ ballot[n] = "none"
    /\ stock + proposal <= capacity
    /\ ballot' = [ballot EXCEPT ![n] = "yes"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, capacity, proposal, mode>>

\* A node rejects the deposit because the result would exceed capacity.
ApproveNo(n) ==
    /\ mode = "voting"
    /\ ballot[n] = "none"
    /\ stock + proposal > capacity
    /\ ballot' = [ballot EXCEPT ![n] = "no"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, capacity, proposal, mode>>

\* With a quorum of approvals the deposit is applied to the shared stock.
Commit ==
    /\ mode = "voting"
    /\ Cardinality({n \in Nodes : ballot[n] = "yes"}) >= QuorumSize
    /\ stock' = stock + proposal
    /\ proposal' = 0
    /\ mode' = "idle"
    /\ ballot' = [n \in Nodes |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED capacity

\* With a quorum of rejections the deposit is discarded.
Abort ==
    /\ mode = "voting"
    /\ Cardinality({n \in Nodes : ballot[n] = "no"}) >= QuorumSize
    /\ proposal' = 0
    /\ mode' = "idle"
    /\ ballot' = [n \in Nodes |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, capacity>>

\* A single unit is issued out, reducing the stock.
Withdraw ==
    /\ mode = "idle"
    /\ stock > 0
    /\ stock' = stock - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity, ballot, proposal, mode>>

\* Fridge capacity is re-rated at runtime, never below the current stock.
Recapacitate(k) ==
    /\ mode = "idle"
    /\ k >= stock
    /\ capacity' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, ballot, proposal, mode>>

Next ==
    \/ \E a \in Amounts : Propose(a)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : ApproveYes(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : ApproveNo(n)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ Withdraw
    \/ \E k \in CapLevels : Recapacitate(k)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bounded capacity is never exceeded: the stored stock always stays within
\* the currently configured fridge capacity.
CapacityRespected == stock <= capacity
====
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker guards a shared cold-storage stock. Every change
to the stock must clear a quorum vote of the tracker's replica nodes.

A clerk proposes a deposit of one or two units (Propose), opening a ballot. Each
node then votes on the pending deposit: it approves (ApproveYes) when the
resulting stock would still fit the fridge's rated capacity, or rejects
(ApproveNo) when the deposit would overflow it. Once a quorum of nodes approve,
the deposit is applied to the shared stock (Commit); if instead a quorum reject,
the deposit is discarded (Abort). Units can also be issued out one at a time
(Withdraw). Between ballots the fridge's rated capacity is re-rated at runtime
(Recapacitate), but it is never lowered below the units already in storage.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the stored blood stock never exceeds the currently configured
fridge capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od5m6p1t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Players, NULL

MaxClock == 3
MaxVer == 3
LeaseLen == 2

VARIABLES clock, holder, leaseEnd, cfgVer, seen
vars == <<clock, holder, leaseEnd, cfgVer, seen>>

\* A shared lobby-config record is leased to one player at a time; seen[p] is
\* the config version player p read when it acquired the lobby.
TypeOK ==
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock
    /\ holder \in Players \cup {NULL}
    /\ leaseEnd \in 0..(MaxClock + LeaseLen)
    /\ cfgVer \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ seen \in [Players -> 0..MaxVer]

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ holder = NULL
    /\ leaseEnd = 0
    /\ cfgVer = 0
    /\ seen = [p \in Players |-> 0]

\* A player acquires the free lobby, taking a lease and reading the version.
Acquire(p) ==
    /\ holder = NULL
    /\ holder' = p
    /\ leaseEnd' = clock + LeaseLen
    /\ seen' = [seen EXCEPT ![p] = cfgVer]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, cfgVer>>

\* The holder edits the lobby, but only while its lease is valid and its read
\* is still current; the edit bumps the version and refreshes what it has seen.
Edit(p) ==
    /\ holder = p
    /\ clock < leaseEnd
    /\ seen[p] = cfgVer
    /\ cfgVer < MaxVer
    /\ cfgVer' = cfgVer + 1
    /\ seen' = [seen EXCEPT ![p] = cfgVer + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, leaseEnd>>

\* A slow-but-alive holder renews its lease before it expires.
Renew(p) ==
    /\ holder = p
    /\ clock < leaseEnd
    /\ leaseEnd' = clock + LeaseLen
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, cfgVer, seen>>

\* An expired lease is reclaimed so another player may acquire the lobby.
Expire ==
    /\ holder # NULL
    /\ clock >= leaseEnd
    /\ holder' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseEnd, cfgVer, seen>>

\* Time advances; a holder that does not renew becomes slow and then expired.
Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, leaseEnd, cfgVer, seen>>

\* The matchmaker rolls its clock over, freeing any dangling lease.
Rollover ==
    /\ clock >= MaxClock
    /\ clock' = 0
    /\ holder' = NULL
    /\ leaseEnd' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cfgVer, seen>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players : Acquire(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Edit(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Renew(p)
    \/ Expire
    \/ Tick
    \/ Rollover

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost update: the player currently holding the lobby lease always has a
\* read version equal to the live config version, so a slow holder cannot
\* overwrite an edit made after its own read.
NoLostUpdate == (holder # NULL) => (seen[holder] = cfgVer)
====

CONSTANTS
    Players = {p1, p2}
    NULL = NULL
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker keeps one shared lobby-config record. A
player must hold an expiring lease to edit the lobby, and records the config
version it read at the moment it acquired the lease.

A player acquires the free lobby (Acquire), taking a lease with a fixed duration
and snapshotting the current config version. While its lease is valid and its
snapshot still matches the live version, the holder may edit the lobby (Edit),
which bumps the version and refreshes its snapshot. A holder that is slow but not
failed can renew its lease before expiry (Renew) to keep ownership. Time advances
(Tick); a holder that fails to renew becomes slow and eventually its lease
expires and is reclaimed (Expire) so another player can acquire the lobby.
Players are never removed, only delayed. The matchmaker periodically rolls its
clock over (Rollover), freeing any dangling lease.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the player currently holding the lobby lease always has a read
version equal to the live config version, so a slow holder never overwrites an
edit made after its own read.
